what_this_binds: the frozen design, the reviewed code and the pinned inputs for S1-S3 and their target-level versions, named before the run rather than after it

design_freeze.governing_unit: target; where a drug-level verdict and its target-level counterpart disagree the target-level verdict governs, and if S2-T fails the drug-target matching claim is withdrawn whatever S1-T shows

review.when: 2026-10-07, before any run on real data, as the registration requires
verified: unique_target_permutations shuffles target indices and indexes by inverse, so every drug of a target receives the same reassigned direction and target group sizes are preserved
target_members and target_representatives both order unique targets through numpy.unique, so the representative lookup is aligned with the permutation's indices
target_representatives refuses if drugs annotated to one target carry different directions
the identity permutation is asserted to reproduce the direct statistic to 1e-9 and the lookup tables to 1e-10 and 1e-12

the three criteria match the registration: S1-T rho >= 0.20 with the 95 percent lower bound above 0, S2-T p_perm < 0.01 over 10,000 unique-target permutations, S3-T 90 percent interval inside plus or minus 0.15
the gate requires all three target-level versions and records the governing unit
defects_found_and_fixed: stage_s1s3 ran the script but left its outputs in the image layer, since the script writes beside its own source and the results volume is mounted at /out; the stage now carries the three outputs onto the volume and refuses to commit a partial run

the gate required manifest keys naming lincs_subset.npz and lincs_shrna.npz, products of the extraction retired under Deviation 12 that the current rebuild never opens; it now pins the sources the rebuild reads, with the GCTX named as trust on first use. Deviation 17.
noted_not_fixed: geometry.target_members documents first-appearance order while numpy.unique returns sorted order; both callers use the same convention so no statistic is affected
the covariate fingerprint comparison cannot fail as written, because nothing mutates M_delta or K inside the permutation loop; it guards a future edit rather than this run

trust_on_first_use.why: stamped on first retrieval, per results/03c_h3_sensitivity/input_pin_check.json; not registered in advance
